# Copilot Instructions

<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilot-instructionsmd-file -->

This is a Flutter app project for a smart pen text recognition system designed to help dyslexic users. The app should:

- Simulate receiving handwritten text from smart pens via WiFi or Bluetooth
- Recognize and process handwritten text for dyslexic readers
- Provide text simplification, definitions, and reading assistance
- Include accessibility features like text-to-speech, large fonts, and high contrast
- Offer reading comprehension aids such as keyword highlighting and simplified explanations
- Use Flutter best practices and Material Design with accessibility in mind
- Mock the text recognition and connectivity features without actual hardware integration

When working with this project, prioritize:
1. Accessibility-first design for dyslexic and visually impaired users
2. Clear, readable UI with high contrast options and large text support
3. Text processing features that help with reading comprehension
4. Proper state management using Provider for text recognition workflow
5. Mock text recognition that simulates realistic handwriting-to-text conversion
6. Inclusive design principles and WCAG compliance
7. Educational and assistive technology best practices
